name: optimize_rust_vec_contains_dedup
description: Vec::contains per element inside a dedup loop -> HashSet; budget calibrated in-container on the debug profile (naive ~1.5s at n=30k vs ~11ms, budget 700ms); wrong-output broken sorts first, losing first-occurrence order
prompts: unique(items) in src/lib.rs returns the distinct values from items in FIRST-OCCURRENCE order - but it checks `out.contains(&x)` against the growing output Vec for every input element, a full linear scan each time, making the function O(n^2). Rewrite it using a HashSet for O(1) membership, returning exactly the same Vec for every input: same first-occurrence order preserved (do not sort). Keep the function name and signature.
